title: Los Alamos working group concludes UFOs are interdimensional
place_text: Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

plain: A working group at Los Alamos National Laboratory, the US government's nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico, is said to have decided sometime in the 2000s that UFOs are interdimensional objects "coming down into a lower dimensional plane." A guest named Jay Anderson tells this second-hand, as something a man he names as Oke Shannon told him, and he ties the idea to Flatland, a book about creatures living in a flat, two-dimensional world. If true, it would mean government scientists had decided these objects come from outside our ordinary three dimensions.
